name: demo-tuned-vs-bm25
report:
# Backtest demo-tuned-vs-bm25 run v2 (simulated, on local)

Hypothesis (pre-registered 2026-11-06): Multi-field BM25 with a price filter beats title-only BM25 on nDCG@10.
Primary metric: ndcg@10, smallest effect that counts: 0.003
Queries: demo-queries@v2:holdout   Judgments: demo-judgments@v1   Population: demo-shoppers@v1

## Offline, from judgments [SIMULATED]

arm                               nDCG@10   P@10   R@50    MRR judged@10
demo-bm25@v1                       0.7729  0.413  0.750  0.703      100%
demo-tuned@v1                      0.8187  0.448  0.773  0.779      100%

## Comparisons (b minus a, paired, 95% bootstrap CI)

* ndcg@10    demo-tuned@v1 vs demo-bm25@v1: +0.0458 [+0.0086, +0.0843] p=0.018  WIN  [SIMULATED]
  p@10       demo-tuned@v1 vs demo-bm25@v1: +0.0347 [+0.0087, +0.0661] p=0.023  WIN  [SIMULATED]
  r@50       demo-tuned@v1 vs demo-bm25@v1: +0.0231 [-0.0024, +0.0548] p=0.124  NOISE  [SIMULATED]
  mrr        demo-tuned@v1 vs demo-bm25@v1: +0.0766 [+0.0404, +0.1168] p=0.000  WIN  [SIMULATED]
  ctr        demo-tuned@v1 vs demo-bm25@v1: +0.0542 [+0.0470, +0.0617] p=0.000  WIN  [SIMULATED]
  conversion demo-tuned@v1 vs demo-bm25@v1: +0.0135 [+0.0095, +0.0175] p=0.000  WIN  [SIMULATED]
  rpv        demo-tuned@v1 vs demo-bm25@v1: +0.8509 [+0.4740, +1.2575] p=0.000  WIN  [SIMULATED]

* primary metric. NOISE means the CI crosses zero or the gain is under the pre-registered minimum.
Simulated results do not prove revenue. A live deploy needs human labels or real traffic.
